title: Maintaining Correct Pipe Pitch to Prevent Drain Bellies
description: Maintaining proper pipe slope is essential for keeping horizontal drainage systems free-flowing and self-scouring. If a drain line lacks adequate pitch or sags due to loose hangers, water moves too slowly to carry solid waste, leading to sediment buildup and frequent clogs. Conversely, extreme pitch can cause liquids to separate from solids. Routine visual maintenance involves checking exposed waste pipes with a torpedo level and verifying that pipe supports are correctly spaced. Fixing sagging sections early prevents standing water, pipe scale, and costly structural repairs down the road.
